run_episode_single: run a single RL episode with an agent in a gym environment and return the trajectory
run_episode_with_max_steps: run an RL episode with an agent and environment, capped at a specified number of steps
evaluate_n_episodes: evaluate an agent over N episodes in a gym environment and return cumulative rewards as a numpy array
evaluate_n_episodes_multiprocess: evaluate an agent over N episodes using multiprocessing and multiple discount gamma values
review_run_episode: review the run_episode function that executes agent-environment interaction loops and collects transitions into a trajectory
